root_causes.title: Estimator freezes forever after any >max_future_s (2 s) silence of all vehicle stamps
root_causes.mechanism: acceptStamp() rejects stamp > latest_ + max_future_s; a rejected stamp never advances latest_, so after a gap (all topics silent, or a zero-stamp window) every later message is rejected. The node/replay still publishes query(t) at each input stamp: a model extrapolation from the frozen committed state (all dropout flags set, speed drifting, up to 4000 integration steps per output).
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp Estimator::acceptStamp (lines 132-148); tbo_replay.cpp main loop / tbo_node.cpp afterInput() publish even when the input was rejected

example_run.stderr: inputs=49290 outputs=46064 invalid_wheel=401 late=455 rejected=11317 merged=0 resets=0 max_buffer=24 map_matched=1

root_causes.code_fix: accept a forward jump when a second message confirms the new time base within 1 s (fix_future_confirm); do not publish for a rejected input

root_causes.title: Frozen (stuck) bogie under braking -> the frozen wheel is trusted, the good one rejected, then no recovery at the stop
root_causes.mechanism: Stuck test compares against the filter speed vc, which the frozen wheel itself holds constant (circular). Under a braking notch an under-reading bogie looks like a plausible slide, so the IMM selects "other bogie bad"; d absorbs the missing deceleration (positive clamp disturbance_max_free=2.0 when notch<=0). After the stop the lock-up guard (never re-anchor to ~0 wheels while the model moves) has no time limit -> phantom motion for the whole dwell.
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp wheelUpdate stuck test (lines 409-421); IMM clamp d_max_pos (line 531); recovery guard (line 607)
root_causes.code_fix: stuck test against the other bogie / model speed change (param stuck_min_change=0 is equivalent: no natural identical run >= 0.5 s while moving except one dying sensor, diagnostics/natural_wheel_stats.json); time-limit the lock-up guard (fix_lockup_guard_s=4)

root_causes.title: Heavy bogie noise -> model-only lock-out and disturbance runaway
root_causes.mechanism: With sigma >= ~1 km/h both bogies drift out of the gates, the IMM settles in "both bad"; its recovery needs |front-rear| < recover_agree (0.35 m/s) on every sample for recover_time_s (3 s) - never true under noise. Meanwhile d (learnt from the noisy wheels, allowed up to +2.0 when the controller is flagged) is integrated open-loop.
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp wheelUpdate recovery (lines 589-617), clampState in the IMM update (line 554)
root_causes.code_fix: agreement test on low-passed bogie speeds (fix_agree_tau_s=2) and |d| <= disturbance_max while both bogies are distrusted (fix_d_clamp_bothbad); adaptive R from the front-rear spread

root_causes.title: Joint slip ramps / low-speed steps are absorbed by the disturbance state
root_causes.mechanism: The joint CUSUM compares bogie acceleration with g*a_drive + clamp(d, +-disturbance_max) where d is the filter's own disturbance estimate. d follows the slipping wheels within ~0.4 s (maneuver mode q_d=8, GPB1 collapse) up to the 0.6 clamp, so the excess seen by the CUSUM stays below cusum_slip_accel.
root_causes.code_fix: reference a slow copy of d frozen while any monitor is active (fix_joint_d_tau_s=20)

root_causes.title: Standstill is never left without wheel data; a lone returning bogie is never trusted
root_causes.mechanism: standstill is cleared only by a bogie sample above threshold, so with both bogies silent predictMode keeps v=0 under traction; when one bogie returns at speed the IMM calls it a slip and recovery needs both bogies.
root_causes.code_fix: leave standstill when both bogies are silent and traction is commanded (fix_standstill_exit); re-anchor to the only available bogie after recover_min_bad_s+recover_time_s (fix_single_recover)

root_causes.title: Transient joint latch inside query() between the W0 and W1 arrivals
root_causes.mechanism: A query at a wheel stamp applies the half-merged event (one bogie only): n_av=1, so a single charged CUSUM counts as a joint alarm and the output shows the rolled-back model speed; the next output is normal. Spikes stay in the 0.3 s CUSUM history and keep a bogie charged for ~2 s. These outputs sit on wheel stamps = the epochs the judge matches (GNSS vel stamps align with wheel stamps).
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp jointMonitor joint alarm (line 778) and history ring (lines 696-700)
root_causes.code_fix: joint alarm needs both bogies unless the other is out (fix_joint_need_both); implausible samples never enter the CUSUM history or the controller check (fix_cusum_skip_bad)
root_causes.skip_bad_note: fix_cusum_skip_bad (both modes) re-introduced false joint latches after zero bursts and weakened lock handling once fix_cmd_check stopped the spurious controller faults that used to disarm the monitors; the recommended set does not use it

root_causes.title: Controller-consistency check fires on wheel anomalies, not on controller faults
root_causes.mechanism: Under a braking notch "impossible" = wheel accel - brake-model accel, so a weaker-than-tabulated brake near a stop, a wheel spinning up after a slide or a spike raises cmd_inconsistent (held 8 s), which disables the slip/slide CUSUMs and raises the positive d clamp to 2.0.
root_causes.code_fix: absolute wheel acceleration under braking notches; no evidence while a bogie is distrusted or within 3 s of a latch release (fix_cmd_check)

root_causes.title: Low-speed wheel lock followed by the maneuver mode -> false standstill
root_causes.mechanism: A lock from ~3 m/s looks like an emergency brake; the maneuver mode (d down to -2.3 m/s^2) follows the wheels below standstill_max_v and the zero-velocity update pins v=0 while the tram still moves.
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp IMM maneuver mode (lines 500-509), standstill guard (line 454)

root_causes.title: Per-bogie scale mismatch (wear) is absorbed by one shared scale state
root_causes.code_fix: separate front/rear scale (or ratio) states calibrated at landmarks

root_causes.title: Total blackout while accelerating: controller assumed neutral after 0.6 s
root_causes.note: cmd_timeout_s=3 is NOT recommended: it delays the cmd-dropout flag (S16 detection 1.00 -> 0.54)

root_causes.title: Re-anchoring with pinVelocity() keeps a large along-track sigma -> wrong landmark association at the next stop
root_causes.mechanism: pinVelocity() zeroes the s-v covariance, so after a long model-only phase the wheel measurements can no longer shrink P_ss (sigma_s stays ~16 m; a normal latch release shrinks it to ~2 m). At the next stop the landmark gate (3 sigma) and the random-stop prior spread over that width let a landmark 17 m away win the association: +16 m along-track error for ~900 s.
root_causes.code: estimator.cpp pinVelocity (lines 78-85) used by the recovery paths (lines 604-616, 664-676); landmarkUpdate association (lines 800-871)
root_causes.code_fix: re-anchor with a scalar Kalman update of v (keeps P_sv, shrinks P_ss) and/or refuse landmark associations while sigma_s exceeds a few metres
